_about: 3-10, added in step 140 (G2): lift_ent_1318 waits at its foot until a touch inside it sends it
(ETHCallback_lift), at 60 units a second, and a touch on it fires no shot ("shot": false). Four portals,
the level's golden score. Left off the start platform, down the ramp and onto the lift; a touch sends it up
(200). From its top - the one place from which the line to the wall's side clears single_block_plat_1275 (x 162-194,
y 106-170); a shot from lower down is stopped on it - a portal at (285, 60) over the left half of
breakable_wall_1316 (tap 358; 57 ticks of flight, it opens on 416) and one beside rolling_stone_1198 at (65, 96) (tap 419,
opens on 425, and the stone goes through): the stone comes out over the wall and breaks it (458) beside knight B
(minion_spawn_913), who took key_ent_1271 on tick 125 and stands on the wall at its wayB1, serving a 15 s hold since
tick ~416, and the knight falls with the key to the ramp (landed 502). Re-authored on the wave's timing build
(round 1, R3): a shot flies 3.2 units a tick, so with step 140's two shots as early as the lift allows (taps 372 and
447, portals on 439 and 453) the wall breaks on tick 472 and the knight does NOT fall: it hangs in the air at
(277.4, 128.3) until its hold ends, on tick ~1356. Probably asleep (the engine's kSleepTime is 0.5 s) with nothing in
this port waking a body whose floor is destroyed, where the original's Box2D does (DestroyBody -> b2Contact::Destroy,
b2Contact.cpp:105-109); the hanging is observed, the sleeping is not verified. Here the stone, coming down at x 285,
rests against the knight and it falls. A touch brings the lift down (446); a portal at (32, 265) over keyhole_ent_1196
(tap 530, opens 551; sooner its point on the view is on the walk pad, a quarter circle of 64 units at the corner) and
one beside the knight at (270, 335) (tap 560, opens 618): the knight goes through (618), lands by the keyhole with
the key, which opens it, and door_locked_ent_1195 goes (627). Right (from 622) down the ramp, under where the door
was, into the door. Won on tick 778 (step 140: 1085, with the knight walked off into enemy_killer_1140, which the win
does not need). Leans on G1 (the knight never sees or shoots) and on a knight carrying a key to its keyhole (keys.json).
Re-flown for the wave 3b-1 time-base build (WT, CAP, G3), same idea and the same four portals. The walk and the lift's
send (200) are the last route's. The lift reaches its top on ~366 and the player stands on it at a centre of y 126.4
from 369; from there the line to (285, 60) is stopped by the corner of single_block_plat_low_emissive_ent_1275 (the shot
ends at (163.2, 111.9)). Aimed at (285, 55), 5 units higher, it clears, so the wall shot goes on 370 (a tap from 364 to
376 wins; 360 is stopped on the platform) and opens on 422. The stone shot (428; 424 to 480 win, 420 is refused, the
wall shot being in flight) opens on 440, the stone comes out at (285, 57) and breaks the wall on 457, and this time the
knight falls at once (it lands on the ramp on ~488) and walks right 0.2 u a tick to rest at x 292.2 from tick ~636. The
lift is sent down on 446 (430 to 450 win; from 470 the keyhole shot below has the walk pad or the lift in its way). From the
lift the keyhole shot to (32, 265) is stopped by the lift itself while the player is high (a tap on 530, his centre at y 208.0, ends at (82.9, 229.4); at y 214.7 it still fails, at 222.4 it clears),
and before tick 540 its point is on the walk pad; it goes on 545 (540 to 550 win) and opens on 568. The shot beside the
knight goes on 590 (580 to 630 win), aimed at (277, 335): the knight at rest is 15 u to its right; a shot to x 287 or
more ends against his body, and he does not go through below x 275. It opens on 640 and the knight goes through at
once, lands by the keyhole with the key (unlocked 647; the keyhole and door_locked_ent_1195 gone on 739). Right from
660 (640 to 670 give the same win), into the door. Won on tick 804.
Re-flown for wave 3b-2's build (R23 the tap's destination, G1a/G1b the knights see, shoot and are crushed, STK), the same four
portals and the same lift, but a different solution. The stone may no longer come out over the knight: knight B stands on the wall's
left end at (276.6, 128.4) from tick ~290, and a stone dropped at x 285 crushes it (a stone's hit above 1.23 kills a knight, G1b: the
key stays in the air where it died). So the wall portal is aimed at the wall's right half, at (340, 30), on a line from the lift's top
that still clears single_block_plat_1275 (tap 342 to 380 win; 362 here, the shot flies 70 ticks and opens on 434), and the stone
shot at (65, 96) goes on 450 (434 to 458 and 462 to 508 win): the stone comes out at (340, 30) and breaks the wall on 483 (hit 4.3),
clear of the knight. The lift goes down on 460 (425 to 447 and 453 to 477 win); the keyhole shot to (32, 265) on 565 (548 to 594 win;
sooner the lift is in its way and the shot fails, no keyhole portal opens) and the shot at (277, 335), where the knight will fall,
on 620 (592 to 696 win). The knight does NOT fall when its wall goes: it hangs at (276.6, 128.4) with its floor destroyed until its
15 s hold ends (tick ~1215), where the original's Box2D wakes a body whose floor is destroyed (b2Contact.cpp:105-109) and this port
wakes a sleeper only for a portal's traveller (sim/Resting) - a port gap, observed, not the route's idea; the route waits it out.
Then the knight walks on, falls through the portal at (277, 335) (1249) and out of the one at (32, 265), lands by the keyhole (1281), and
its key opens it (1320), the door going on 1370. The player waits on the lift's foot or a few steps right of it (the hold to 684
leaves him at x ~170; at x 258 or more the knight's fall lands on him and he dies on ~1374): a knight in his row sees him on its
landing (spots 1276), shoots on 1317, and the shot, 2 u a tick to where he stood, ends there on 1386; he walks right from 1320
(1225 to 1355 win; earlier he is under the knight's fall and dies on 1330-1350), 2.4 u a tick, ahead of a shot at 2.0 and gone from
the spot when it ends, on to the stone against the door, which he pushes ahead when the door goes (1370), into the door on 1435.
